observations: Photo 0: tabletop gas cooker with 4 visible burners (3 gas flame burners + 1 large circular electric/solid hotplate-looking burner).
Photo 1: top view shows 4 gas burners with blue flames lit, plus 2 circular electric/solid hotplate-looking burners (total 6 cooking zones visible).
Photo 2: side/back view shows a built-in/standing unit with a glass/metal top and control panel; no clear brand/model label readable.

identity.kind: 6-burner gas/electric cooker (4 gas burners + 2 hotplates) / standing gas cooker

claims.claim: 4 Gas cooker and 2 burner making 6 burner in total.
claims.evidence: Photo 1 shows 4 gas burners with blue flames and 2 circular hotplate-style burners; photo 0 also shows mixed gas + hotplate zones.
Photo 1 shows burners lit at the time of the photo, but there is no proof of long-term performance, ignition consistency, thermostat control, or that all burners work under load.

risks.risk: Some burners may not ignite reliably or may have weak flame/uneven heating (photo only shows a moment with flames).
risks.proof: Ask for a short video clip showing ignition of each of the 6 zones one-by-one (including the 2 hotplates) and then a 5–10 minute continuous burn test.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven/possible faults (worst case: treat as used with unknown reliability).

risks.risk: The 2 non-gas burners may be electric hotplates that require power; if the buyer only has gas setup, they may be unusable.
risks.proof: Ask for a photo of the rating plate/label and a clip showing the hotplates heating when powered (or confirm they are gas burners if that is the case).
risks.if_unproven: Price as gas-only usable (worst case: hotplates not usable/unknown).

risks.risk: Missing/unclear brand/model and build quality; could be a lower-grade unit or have parts issues not visible.
risks.proof: Ask for a clear photo of the brand/model label and the full control knobs/igniter area.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lower end of similar used cookers.

risks.risk: Condition issues (scratches, dents, burner cap wear, grease buildup) that affect value.
risks.proof: Ask for close-up photos of burner caps, pan supports/grates, and the control panel knobs.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the rating plate/brand & model label (or any sticker) on the cooker.
Send a short video: ignite each of the 4 gas burners one-by-one, then demonstrate the 2 hotplates heating (show power source if electric).
Close-up photos of burner caps/grates and the igniter/control knobs.
response.reason: The photos clearly show a 6-zone cooker layout (4 gas flames + 2 circular hotplate-style burners). The only unverified part is “all working perfectly,” so it should be priced at the worst case within the comparable range.
